balls.text: he nearly got the hat-trick! Kumble backed away to make room and lofted the ball towards extra cover, Murali ran forward and dived full length but couldn't quite reach the ball, they run a single and then run another for an unnecessary overthrow
Morkel's on a hat-trick! Vinay Kumar tries to slog across the line, Morkel angles the good length ball into off stump and uproots it after the batsman fails to connect with his swing
bowled him! Morkel fires in the yorker on middle stump, Praveen backs away to hit through the off side and gets comprehensively bowled
Akhil tries to pull this time and mis-hits it just over the bowler's head
Praveen tries to pull but the length from Morkel isn't short enough for the shot, he hits the ball for  a single to long-off
Praven plays the ball towards midwicket and doesn't take the single
Akhil tries to play a rather ambitious sweep to a ball outside off stump and gets beaten, Praveen has the strike for the final over
full ball outside off stump, Akhil makes room and hits the ball straight to Dhoni
short of a length this time, Praveen pulls through midwicket for a single
that's the first six! Praveen backs away to create room to free his arms and swings his bat hard to smash the ball flat over the extra cover boundary
another slower ball but this time Praveen spots it early, he waits for the ball and lofts it straight back over the bowler's head for four
starts off with a slower ball on off and middle, Praveen moves across his stumps and plays the ball behind square off his pads
a half-volley on leg stump, Akhil accepts it gleefully and moves across his stumps to glance the ball to the fine leg boundary
short of a length this time from Ntini, angling the ball into the right-hander, Praveen fends the ball off the back foot towards the off side
full and wide outside off stump, Praveen frees his arms and lashes the ball over cover for four
this time he makes a bit of room and drives a full ball towards long-on to bring up the 100, this is the third slowest hundred in the competition
Ntini fires the ball into the block-hole from wide of the crease, not much Akhil can do with that, he defends back to the bowler
Praveen walks across his stumps and flicks a full ball off his pads towards deep backward square leg, nice shot but it's fraught with danger
he gets off the mark by driving a full toss towards long on for one more

caught! Dravid's gone after playing yet another lone hand, he backs away towards leg to make room and drives a full ball hard and flat towards cover where Dhoni leans forward and takes the catch inches off the ground
fuller ball angling into the right-hander, Dravid moves forward leg and drives the ball into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on, just two this time
this time he makes room and drives a full length ball towards deep point, he comes back for the second
Dravid makes uses of Morkel's angle into him and flicks a full ball towards deep midwicket for four more
full ball in the block hole, Dravid flicks it towards midwicket where the fielder dives and parries the ball towards mid-on, the batsmen run two off the rebound
slower ball on off stump at 103 kmh, Dravid moves back and cuts the ball down to third man
a full ball outside off stump, driven off the front foot to cover
too short and Dravid pulls the ball powerfully off the front foot through midwicket for four more, he's getting a move on once again
that's the first six! Or is it? Dravid gets down on one knee and frees his arms to slice a full ball from outside off stump towards deep backward point, the ball bounces just inside the boundary
the slower ball at 103 kmh, nudged towards the leg side off the back foot for a quick single
chipped in the air towards long-off for a single

lbw! Morkel slips in the yorker and Boucher tries to play across the line towards the leg side, he misses and gets hit flush on the boot, that is going on to hit leg stump and umpire Harper sends Boucher on his way
Boucher makes room by moving towards leg and lofts the ball over cover with a flat bat, four more
Dravid moves forward and slogs the ball flat towards long on from outside off, the ball reaches the fielder on the bounce
that's an identical shot, Boucher drives the over-pitched delivery straight down the ground but he's not timed it as well, long-on cuts it off
that's too full on middle stump, Boucher makes room and drives the ball hard and straight, he's hit it so well that long-on has no chance
bowled full into the block hole on middle and leg, Dravid digs the ball out towards long on
Boucher steps out of his crease and tries to work the ball through the leg side, he gets beaten in the flight and the ball hits his pad, Murali's finished his spell, 4-0-19-1
bowled flatter and quicker outside off stump, Dravid moves on to the back foot and cuts through point
played off the front foot with an open face towards short third man
Boucher steps out of his crease and drives the full toss inside out through cover
played off the pads behidn square for one more
width offered outside off, Dravid moves quickly on to the back foot and cuts the ball late past the fielder at short third man
Boucher moves forward to drive but mis-times the ball back to the bowler
Dravid backs away towards leg to create room and cuts a short of a length ball hard towards deep point where Gony fields
driven off the front foot towards long-on, midwicket tries to cut it off but can't
pushed off the back foot towards mid-on
shot! Boucher leans across and flicks an over-pitched delivery between mid-on and midwicket for four
Boucher moves outside the line of off stump and tries to flick a full ball through midwicket, he misses and gets hit on the pad, Morkel appeals but the impact was outside off
Boucher moves back and pulls a short of a length ball towards deep midwicket
fuller length on off stump, Dravid drives off the front foot to long-off
that's too short and Dravid moves on to the front foot, rolls his wrists and pulls the ball along the ground to the midwicket boundary
Boucher moves forward and outside the line of off stump and works the ball off his pads towards long leg
Dravid moves on to the back foot and punches through cover for a single
good length delivery outside off stump, Dravid cuts to cover where Dhoni, yes Dhoni who isn't keeping today, prevents the single
Boucher strides forward and defends back to the bowler
Dravid moves back and cuts towards deep point
defended on the front foot back to the bowler
Dravid closes the face of the bat on the front foot and the doosra hits the leading edge and runs towards third man
defended on the front foot towards cover

caught, superbly by Parthiv! The short of a length delivery angles into Misbah from over the wicket, cramping him for room, Misbah tries to steer the ball towards third man but gets a thick outside edge that flies into the gap between the keeper and first slip, Parthiv dives full length to his right and grabs the catch with one hand, first slip was standing wide so Parthiv had to go for it and he did brilliantly
that's a pretty sharp bouncer outside off stump, Misbah plays a half-hearted hook and gets beaten
fuller length from Balaji, angling into middle stump, Dravid leans across and whips the ball off his pads through square leg
Dravid moves forward and steers the ball towards short third man
a short of a length ball keeps Misbah in his crease, he jumps on to the back foot and nudges the ball towards square leg
starts off with a good length ball which angles into the off stump, Dravid stays on the back foot and opens the face to run the ball to third man
played towards deep midwicket for two more to end the over
Dravid leans forward and closes the face of the bat to play the ball towards the leg side
driven towards long-on for a single
defended on the front foot towards point
pushed towards the leg side for a single

brilliantly caught but Morkel's hurt himself, Kohli pulls the ball high in the air towards deep midwicket, Morkel initially mis-judges the catch and comes forward before he begins to back-pedal to try and get into position, he jumps backwards to take the catch and he's in mid-air as he takes it, he falls awkwardly on one knee and then hits his head on the ground as he falls backwards, he's managed to stay within the boundary by a foot so it's a fantastic effort
nudged off the back foot towards the leg side, Gony ends an excellent spell, 2 for 11 off four over, splendid

there's a mix-up but both batsmen are safe, Kohli comes forward and drives the ball towards mid-on, Dravid sets off from the non-striker's end but Kohli sends him back, then Kohli sets off but turns back again, the throw comes to the bowlers end but Dravid gets back in time
good length ball outside off stump, Dravid moves back in his crease and runs the ball towards third man with an open face
Kohli tries to loft over midwicket but mis-times the ball towards square leg
banged in short, too short and that's a wide for height
Dravid tries to hit down the ground but gets an inside edge towards long leg, Gony is bowling a tight wicket to wicket line
Kohli tries to work a good length ball towards square leg but gets struck high on the pad
Dravid moves his front foot outside the line of off stump and tries to sweep, he misses and gets hit on the pad
played off the pads through square leg for two more
width offered outside the off stump, Kohli moves on to the back foot and cuts the ball towards deep point
a full toss on middle and leg, Dravid moves across his stumps and sweeps the ball firmly towards fine leg
Dravid moves forward and across and flicks a flatter ball towards midwicket
Dravid moves on to the front foot and defends on the leg side
that's a wild wild slog, Kohli moves his front foot out of the way and throws his bat at the ball, not too sure where he wanted to hit it but he missed
a short of a length ball angles into Dravid's ribs, he jumps on to the back foot and fends the ball down on the leg side
good length ball outside off stump, Dravid waits on the back foot and shoulders arms

another huge appeal for caught behind and Goswami's walked! The umpire shook his head and turned the appeal down but the batsmen decided to go. Gony pitched short of a length and angled the ball across the left-hander's off stump, Goswami tried to drive on the up but only managed an edge through to Parthiv
short of a length once again outside off stump, Goswami tries to cut through the off side but can't find the gap
there's a bit of width outside off stump and Goswami uses it to cut the ball towards point
short of a length delivery angling into the right-hander, Kohli moves back and plays the ball towards point
Goswami backs away towards leg and mis-hits the attempted loft towards wide mid-on

this time Gony does splendidly to cut it off, the length is just short and Kohli runs the ball wide of the fielder at first slip, Gony runs at top speed across the third-man boundary and picks up the ball cleanly
fuller length homing in on off stump, Kohli strides forward and drives towards point

Ntini angles the ball sharply into off stump from wide of the crease, Kohli waits for the ball and opens the face late to guide the ball towards third man, Gony dives on the boundary but he can't stop it
Ntini pitches short of a length outside off stump, Kolhi strides towards the ball and punches towards point
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Goswami gets on top of the bounce and cuts towards third man
Kohli moves across his stumps to a short of a length delivery and nudges the ball off his hips towards fine leg
Goswami drops the ball with soft hands towards cover and calls his under-19 captain through for  a single
that's ambitious, Goswami tees off and tries to loft Gony from outside off stump straight down the ground, superb bat speed but he doesn't make contact
Goswami moves forward and defends towards the bowler
nudged towards the leg side for a single towards square leg

Ntini's convinced he's got him but Harper isn't, a good length ball nips back into the left-hander after slanting across him and Goswami plays outside the line, the ball passes very close to the bottom edge and there is a sound as the ball passes the bat
shot boy! Goswami moves forward, picks up the length early and lofts Ntini with a perfectly straight bat back over his head for four
defended on the front foot back to the bowler

edged and dropped! Fleming floors it this time, Goswami fends at a good length delivery that bounces sharply and angles across him at pace, he gets an outside edge that flies straight to Fleming at first slip, he catches it, fumbles, tries to catch it again, fumbles again and finally drops it
Ntini hits a good length around leg stump and angles into ball into middle and off, Goswami pushes off the front foot towards the off side
Ntini's length pins Goswami on to the back foot and he gets hit on the pad as he tries to flick
Kohli moves forward and opens the face of the back to steer the ball towards short third man, an excellent bit of fielding saves runs
good length on off stump, Kohli gets behind the line and defends on the back foot

caught! Kallis poor tournament rolls on, Gony pitches the ball short of a length just outside off and angles the ball into Kallis who gets squared up as the ball straightens off the pitch, he tries to defend on the back foot but the outside edge flies straight to Fleming at first slip
good length delivery pitches outside off and angles into the right hander, Kallis gets behind the line and blocks
width offered outside off stump, Goswami waits on the back foot and cuts to third man
short of a length delivery gets high on Goswami as it angles across him, he lets it go
too short and too wide outside off stump, Kallis stands tall on the back foot and cuts the ball hard through point for four
Goswami backs away towards leg to make room and cuts the ball from his stumps towards third man for a single
defended off the back foot towards the off side, Goswami wants the single but it isn't there

massive appeal for lbw but umpire Harper says not out, Ntini pitches the ball on a good length and slants the ball across Goswami who fends away from his body and gets beaten, not sure if he nicked it or not but Harper wasn't convinced with the appeal, Goswami is extremely short so Ntini's good length balls get high on him
short of a length outside off stump, Kallis stands on the back foot and steers the ball towards third man
good length delivery pitches outside off and angles into Kallis who hangs his bat out at it and gets beaten

Praveen strolls in off two steps and bowls a slow ball, Ntini tries to hit a six over midwicket and misses, he gets hit on the pad, Raina walks off disappointed after shaking hands, he lost the plot towards the end when wickets were falling in a hurry
full ball outside off stump, Ntini swings and misses, Dravid is pumped
bowled full and wide outside off stump, Ntini swings and misses, Bangalore will win this if Praveen can bowl two legal balls
full toss and Raina hits it down the ground towards long-off, he's taken the single this time, I don't quite understand that, he's left Ntini with 15 to get off three balls
another full ball in the blockhole outside off, Raina digs it out on the off side and refuses the single once again, Rania now needs to hit four  fours
the slower ball bowled full from round the wicket, Raina tries to drive but gets an inside edge on the leg side, Raina refuses the single
bowled full outside off stump, Ntini drives the ball to deep cover and sets off for the single, he's almost half-way down when Raina sends him back, he wants the strike for the final over
Steyn fires in an excellent bouncer outside off stump, Ntini ducks under it
bowled full and fast outside off stump, Ntini tries to drive but gets beaten
short of a length delivery on leg and middle, nudged off the hips behind square for a single

Balaji is run out! Steyn fires in a quick short ball, Balaji tries to pull but hits it towards cover where Dravid fields and throws the ball to the bowler's end, Goswami gets to the stumps before the bowler and breaks the stumps with Balaji miles short
that is extremely wide outside off stump, Balaji was moving outside off to hit the ball through leg but Steyn sprayed it even wider
a clever change of pace, the slower ball outside off stump, Balaji gets beaten comprehensively
Balaji also tries to pull a short of a length delivery and gets an outside edge towards the short third man region
Praveen bowls a well-directed bouncer, Balaji ducks

caught! Priceless wicket and a dot ball, Gony creates room and tries to pull a short of a length delivery from outside off stump towards the leg side, he mis-hits it straight to Steyn who takes the catch on the edge of the circle at mid-off
Praveen gets his length wrong and pays for it, the ball is too short and it's slow as well, Gony moves his front foot out of the way and pulls the ball to wide long on for four more
that's too wide outside off stump, Gony tries to smash it by clearing his front foot out of the way but misses, he was trying to hit it over midwicket when it was a wide outside off
Praveen tries to find the block hole and Raina pushes the low full toss towards long-on for only a single
too full, Praveen angles the delivery into Raina and he lofts the ball through the line back over the bowler's head for four, superb shot

Gony mis-times the pull towards midwicket, Raina sets off for the single but Gony sends him back, Raina lost his footing as he turned around and a direct hit at the bowler's end would have been extremely close
Kallis tests him with the bouncer first up, Gony takes his eyes off the ball and tries to hook and duck at the same time, he gets beaten
good length from Kallis angling into off stump, Raina opens the face and steers the ball towards third man
Raina backs away yet again and tries to loft inside out on the up over cover, he gets beaten once again

Raina moves back and plays the square drive to a good length ball through cover point, Vinay Kumar slides on the boundary but doesn't stop it cleanly, he tries to save it again on the second attempt but touches the boundary as he pulls the ball back in
Raina backs away towards leg and tries to loft a good length delivery into orbit over cover, he gets beaten

what a catch! Kallis has taken a blinder! Vidyut tries to pull a short ball that hurries  on to him far too quickly, he mis-hits the ball and it lobs up towards short midwicket, Kallis runs to his right from midwicket and dives full length to take the catch inches off the ground, splendid effort
Vidyut gets pinned on the back foot by Steyn's short length and he defends on the off side
short of a length delivery on middle and off, defended off the back foot towards point

caught in the deep! Steyn bowls the short ball and Morkel plays the hook, he's hit it in the air towards deep square leg where Vinaykumar takes an easy catch, he hardly had to move for the ball came straight to him, Bangalore are cock-a-hoop
Morkel pushes a good length ball towards mid-off, Morkel sends Raina back and he barely manages to make his ground, a direct hit and it would have been close
pushed off the back foot with soft hands towards cover for a single
driven uppishly towards the off side for a single

fuller ball on leg stump, Raina nudges the ball off his pads and sprints for the single, he comes back for two as Boucher scampers across to field and makes his ground, the throw came to the keeper's end and Goswami, who is a fielder today, didn't whip off the bails, I suspect the batsman was safe though
Morkel doesn't have room once again but manages to cut the ball in front of Kohli at point for a single
short of a length delivery angles into the left-hander, cramping Morkel for room, he defends off the back foot towards the off side
banged in short and the ball rises sharply on Morkel who tries to cut but gets beaten by the bounce
good length delivery outside off stump, pushed off the back foot toward the off side

lbw! Badrinath moves dangerously across his stumps and gets hit on the pad by a full ball after he misses the sweep, Kumble appeals and Harper agrees, that hit him in line with off stump and would have gone on to hit the stumps
Badrinath strides forward to a good length ball and defends on the off side
Raina gets down on one knee and tries to sweep, he misses and gets hit on the pad for a leg bye
played towards midwicket off the front foot

this time he's definitely out! Fleming gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps Kumble, who I suspect bowled a seam-up delivery, straight into Akhil's hands at deep square leg, he's taken well-judged catch while running forward
bowled full on middle and leg, Fleming drives towards long-on
full delivery on middle and leg, driven off the front foot towards deep midwicket

bowled him! Fleming backs away towards leg stump and tries to hit a full ball across the line towards the leg side, he misses and Vinaykumar hits the leg stump which gets uprooted and proceeds to smack Boucher on the knee just above the pad, Fleming's out but Boucher's down on the ground in some pain, whoops, Fleming's got a very lucky break, the umpire spotted that there were only three men in the circle and called a no-ball, Fleming stays and it's all very dramatic, did I mention that Fleming's bat flew out of his hand after the shot?
good length from Vinaykumar on middle and off, Raina moves back and punches towards long-off
fuller length on middle and off, Fleming drives off the front foot straight down the ground
short and wide outside off, Fleming frees his arms and swats the ball flat and hard over cover for four more
played towards midwicket off the front foot
massive hit! Fleming plants his front foot forward and lofts Vinay Kumar through the line, he hits the the ball on to the terrace at the cover boundary
Raina stays in his crease and pushes the ball through midwicket
Fleming tries to loft over the in-field on the of side but mis-times the shot, it falls short and wide of the fielder at mid-off
defended on the front foot towards the leg side
Raina moves back to a short of a length delivery on middle and off and punches on the up through cover for another single
Fleming flicks the ball off his pads towards fine leg for a single, "Come on boys, one more wicket," chirps Boucher.
played off the back foot towards third man and Raina's off the mark

he doesn't time it this either and he's caught! Dhoni tries to get under a good length ball and loft it out of the ground, he doesn't get enough elevation or distance and holes out to Kumble at long-on
Dhoni stands in his crease and lofts the ball inside out over extra cover, he didn't time it well enough to find the boundary
good length delivery angles into Dhoni's middle stump, he defends on the back foot towards the bowler
Fleming backs away to make room and hits a good length ball towards long-on
tight line and length on middle and off, Fleming moves forward and drives towards the off side
driven off the front foot past the bowler for a single
Fleming strides forward and nudges a slower ball off his pads towards midwicket
Kumble drops a bit short and Dhoni gets going by moving back in his crease and working the ball behind square
Kumble's keeping it flat and quick on middle stump, defended on the front foot
Dhoni takes a few steps out of his crease and blocks
bowled flat and fast on middle stump, defended on the front foot

caught! With a lot of luck! I've never seen one like this before! Parthiv stepped out of his crease and drove the ball hard straight back at Kumble who failed to hold on at the first attempt, the ball bounced out of his hands and hit the non-striker Fleming on the shoulder and popped up for Kumble to take the catch off the rebound, it might have hit Fleming's shoulder and his hand actually
worked off the pads through square leg for a single
Fleming moves across his stumps to a good length ball and flicks off his pads towards fine leg
cut off the back foot towards point where the fielder picks it up with one had
played towards short third man for a single
steered towards third man off the back foot
defended back to the bowler

dropped! Bangalore look disconsolate! Parthiv tries to pull a short of a length ball that gets big on him, he gets a top edge that goes high in the air in the region between midwicket and mid-on, Dravid runs towards the ball from midwicket, Kumble goes for the catch from mid-on, no one calls for it and Dravid pulls out of the catch at the last moment and Kumble, who is evidently distracted, drops it, Kallis goes red in the face
a good length delivery angles into the left-hander, Parthiv moves across his crease and defends on the leg side
that's too close to cut, the extra bounce outside off stump beats Parthiv
Fleming stays on the back foot and steers a good length ball from outside off to third man
short of a length but closer to the stumps, Parthiv moves forward and nudges the ball off his pads towards midwicket
short of a length outside off stump, Fleming moves towards the ball and cuts to third man
bowled flat on leg stump by Kumble, Fleming leans across and nudges the ball off his pads towards square leg
Parthiv takes a stride forward and across his stumps and drives a full ball through midwicket
Fleming comes forward and drives the ball in the air but wide of the fielder at mid-on
that's horribly wide outside leg stump, that would have been called but Fleming reached out for the ball and paddle-swept towards fine leg
width offered outside off stump and Fleming rocks back to cut the ball with tremendous power through covers for four
Fleming leans forward to drive a ball from middle and off and gets an edge to short third man
punched off the back foot towards the off side
Parthiv plays a loose shot away from his body and gets beaten

Flemign tries to cut a ball that is too close to him and gets a bottom edge that bounces towards Boucher, Parthiv sets off for the single and Boucher tries to run out Fleming at the bowler's end, he misses the stumps, Fleming was running straight down the pitch to block Boucher's view of the stumps
a good length ball angles into off and middle from round the wicket, Fleming stays in his crease and defends on the leg side
Parthiv moves back and gets cramped for room by the short of a length delivery that slants into him, he pushes the ball towards mid-on for a single
short of a length delivery outside the off stump, Parthiv tries to cut off the back foot but gets beaten
Parthiv moves across his stumps and works the ball off his pads wide of the fielder at short fine leg, tidy start from Kumble, only two off the over
Parthiv tries to sweep but doesn't make contact
Patel tries to loft Kumble overs the off side but mis-hits it towards mid-off, that fell short of the fielder
bowled fuller on leg and middle, Fleming steps forward and drives the ball towards long-on for a single
defended on the front foot towards the leg side
slips in the flatter and faster ball across the left-hander, Fleming tries to cut but gets beaten
Parthiv strides forward and defends towards cover with bat and pad close together, that would have fit right into a Test match
slower ball on off stump, pushed off the front foot through point
that's the first six! Fleming swivels and hooks a short ball that angles into him from round the wicket over the long-leg boundary, he wasn't in the greatest position but kept his balance
wide outside off stump, that's a freebie and Fleming shakes off his shackles by freeing his arms and carving the ball over cover, he hit it with tremendous bat speed
straighter line from Praveen on a good length, Fleming takes a step forward and drives towards cover
Fleming strides on to the front foot and guides the ball towards point with an angled bat
Parthiv gets behind the line of a good length ball and punches straight, it's superbly timed and luckily for the bowler the ball hits the stumps at his end, that would have been four otherwise
good length from Steyn on middle and off, Parthiv moves on to the back foot and pushes towards point
short of a length delivery on off stump, defended on the back foot towards the off side
super shot! Steyn bowls the slower ball on leg and middle, Parthiv makes room by moving towards leg and drives the ball firmly past mid-off for four more
now Steyn over-steps while bowling a short ball and Parthiv pulls the ball through square leg for four more, this is going horribly wrong for Bangalore, free hit coming up
steyn replies with an angry bouncer and the ball sails over Boucher's head as well for four wides, that hasn't helped Bangalore
outstanding shot! Steyn pitches too full outside off stump, Parthiv gets a long stride forward and drives the ball powerfully through cover for four
Parthiv barely manages to clear short midwicket with his pull and gets two runs towards wide mid-on
Fleming moves on to the front foot and opens the face to play the ball behind point for two runs to third man
Fleming moves forward and once again gets squared up by the ball that pitches close to off stump and moves away from him, he defends awkwardly on the off side
excellent length and line outside off stump, Fleming moves on to the front foot and lifts his bat out of the way
a short of a length delivery pitches around off stump and seams away from Fleming, squaring him up, he fends off the back foot and gets beaten
closer to off stump this time with a hint of movement into the left-hander, Fleming strides forward and blocks
pitches on a good length outside off stump and nips the ball off the pitch away from the left-hander, Fleming strides forward and lets the ball go
Parthiv moves on to the front foot and defends towards the leg side
a full ball swings into Parthiv's off and middle stump, he moves forward and tries to drive through the on-side but gets an inside edge on to the pad
angles a short of a length ball into the left-hander, Parthiv defends on the back foot towards the bowler
short and wide outside off stump, plenty of room and time for Parthiv to jump on to the back foot and cut the ball over point for the first boundary of the innings
fuller length on middle and off, Parthiv comes on to the front foot and drives the ball back at the bowler, Steyn sticks his left boot out and stops the ball
banged in short but the line is down leg side, Chennai are away with an extra
starts off with a good length delivery that pitches in line with the stumps and angles across the left-hander, Parthiv defends on the front foot towards cover
